data.policy: the acceptance oracle is read only by the acceptance step; search and validation code must not open it, and access counts are budgeted per run

preprocessing.modality_mask: a 2-element presence vector accompanies the features

metrics.complete_input_accuracy: correct / (holdout rows with both modalities present)
metrics.coverage: answered / (holdout rows with a missing modality)
metrics.report_rule: complete-input accuracy and missing-input coverage/answered-accuracy are reported side by side and never averaged into a single number

errors.abstain_is_not_error: an abstain on a decidable row is counted as wrong
errors.abstain_required: an answer on a missing-modality row is counted as coverage, and the gate expects zero coverage
errors.timeout: counts as failure, never silently dropped from the denominator
errors.non_finite: a NaN or infinite output counts as failure

seed_plan.rule: each seed trains from scratch and re-evaluates; the report states per-seed numbers and their mean, never a single best run

measurement.determinism: deterministic algorithms and fixed seeds are required on CPU; bitwise equality is not promised on GPU

selection.publish_requires: holdout gates in task.json must pass
selection.best_of_runs: mean over the 3 seed runs; a single lucky run cannot promote a model
selection.budget_shared: the acceptance set may be evaluated a limited number of times per run; forks share the parent's remaining budget
